A DGID communique of 27 August 2026 says SENTAX now replaces the ETAX application for tax declaration and payment by DGE taxpayers.

The DGID's SENTAX platform handles online tax declaration and payment, mandatory for all declarations and payments of Large Enterprise Directorate (DGE) taxpayers from 1 September 2026 and open to CME1, CME2 and CPR taxpayers from 1 October 2026, with paper returns no longer accepted.
The DGID says SENTAX replaces the ETAX application for tax declaration and payment by DGE taxpayers from 1 September 2026.

The Treasury's 2024 activity report says revenue and expenditure operations between its ASTER accounting system and SIGCDD were automated in 2024, and audits the internal accounting controls built into ASTER.

Terms of reference of November 2023 for a government enterprise architecture list among the state's high-impact systems in use the finance ministry's payroll (eSolde), the tax directorate's etax and SIGTAS, and the Treasury's ASTER.
